scope.focus: keyword-based output feedback feeding persistent self/personality state

mechanism.analyzer: keyword/sub-string heuristic over Frank reply only
mechanism.confidence_rule: count distinct high/low lexical markers; confident iff high > low+1, uncertain iff low > high+1, otherwise neutral
mechanism.downstream: returns E-PQ event_type and flags consumed by output-feedback loops including EgoConstruct.process_own_response

executed_probe.kind: deterministic reproduction of source scoring rule

cases.reply: Das ist klar, definitiv und eindeutig: 2 + 2 = 5.
Ich bin mir nicht sicher; vielleicht ist 2 + 2 = 4.

executed_probe.conclusion: The source's confidence score measures lexical assertiveness/hedging, not epistemic correctness.

negative_results.result: A confidently worded false statement scores 0.9 while a hedged true statement scores 0.2 under the exact source rule.
negative_results.impact: Lexical style is not an epistemic-confidence signal and must never drive truth, calibration or promotion.

negative_results.result: The analyze_response(user_input=...) parameter is not used in the implementation.
negative_results.impact: The loop cannot compare the reply to the initiating user request, requested task, evidence or outcome; it is self-referential by construction.

negative_results.result: Substring matching lacks token/negation/context semantics and counts marker presence rather than calibrated evidence.
negative_results.impact: Phrases can accidentally trigger confidence/tone classes and language/style changes alter persistent self-state without task-outcome change.

negative_results.result: Tone is collapsed by fixed precedence even when several modes are simultaneously present.
negative_results.impact: A multi-dimensional response state is lossy before feedback is applied, creating attribution error in personality/self-state updates.

current_inheritance.delta: Keep response-style observation as a low-authority metacognitive feature only. Epistemic confidence and causal credit must bind to evidence, requested-task predicates and verified outcomes/state deltas.

Do not use model verbal confidence about recognition as classifier confidence. Calibrate on held-out labeled visual examples/open-set negatives and preserve disagreement between visual evidence and language projection.
Add adversarial probes where false answers are assertive and true answers are hedged; require no truth/agency promotion from wording alone. Also test negation and multilingual marker drift.
Separate response_style_observation from epistemic_confidence, outcome_evidence and causal_credit. No implicit coercion between these types.
Persist style signals, model self-report, verifier result and external outcome as separate provenance-bearing fields so later analysis can measure self-report calibration rather than overwrite truth.

earned_work.reason: Strong negative-result/anti-Goodhart value but overlaps broader historical output-feedback and self-state work; dedup required.

level0_effect.reason: One additional frozen-head semantic code unit analyzed; global PF denominator remains unfrozen.
